**Gone.** There is no check-in on appointments any more: the carrier's
arrival is recorded at the gate by yard-management (`POST /visits`
naming the `appointmentId`) and dock-scheduling derives the
appointment's check-in from it (ADR 0019). Always `410`
`appointment-moved`.
